title: Evaluate the scanner through local Plexus
description:
Purpose: Run DataParade scanner evaluations through a local Plexus control plane so recall is comparable across runs. Transport is the Plexus CLI, not MCP. GraphQL is the local FastAPI server. Each gold annotation is a Plexus Item. One scorecard with one Python Score subclass calls the scanner just-in-time per repo, caches the scan on the score instance, and returns Yes/No detected.

Agreed direction (2026-08-27), still to be massaged before implementation:
- No AWS / AppSync / Cognito for this project
- CLI golden path: plexus evaluate accuracy, then --baseline for comparison
- Tactus is not the score implementation
- Precision is a separate initiative: DATAP-d73a91
- Storage backend for local GraphQL is still being designed (file-backed FastAPI, no database server)

Exclusions:
- Implementing precision in the first recall scorecard
- MCP as the evaluation transport
- Dumping a JSON blob via evaluations create / evaluation.ingest

Definition of Done for planning:
- Child epics cover the Score class, Item/dataset mapping, and CLI run path
- Storage backend decision recorded (Plexus-side)
- No implementation until the plan is massaged and accepted

Precision: DATAP-d73a91 (backlog), not this initiative.

Storage: local FastAPI should not require Postgres for DataParade. File-backed store is Plexus-side; record there and link here when filed.

Supersedes warehouse-ingest thinking (DATAP-6bd634 / evaluation.ingest). Agreed path is evaluate accuracy, not createEvaluation dumps.
